# verda ssh-key

> Verda CLI **v1.10.0** · [other versions](https://github.com/verda-cloud/verda-cli/tags)

Manage SSH keys

Create, list, and delete SSH keys used for VM authentication.

Subcommands:

- [`verda ssh-key add`](#verda-ssh-key-add): Add an SSH key
- [`verda ssh-key delete`](#verda-ssh-key-delete): Delete an SSH key
- [`verda ssh-key list`](#verda-ssh-key-list): List SSH keys

## verda ssh-key add

Add an SSH key

Add a new SSH key to your account. In interactive mode you will be
prompted for the key name and public key. Use --name and --public-key
flags for non-interactive use.

**Usage**

```text
verda ssh-key add [flags]
```

**Flags**

```text
      --name string         SSH key name
      --public-key string   SSH public key content
```

**Examples**

```bash
# Interactive
verda ssh-key add

# Non-interactive
verda ssh-key add --name my-key --public-key "ssh-ed25519 AAAA..."
```

## verda ssh-key delete

Delete an SSH key

Delete an SSH key from your account. In interactive mode you will be
prompted to select a key and confirm deletion. Pass the key id as an
argument or with --id for non-interactive use. Agent mode requires an
id and --yes.

**Usage**

```text
verda ssh-key delete [<id>] [flags]
```

Aliases: `rm`

**Flags**

```text
      --id string   SSH key ID to delete (alternative to the positional argument)
      --yes         Skip confirmation for destructive actions (required in agent mode)
```

**Examples**

```bash
# Interactive
verda ssh-key delete

# Non-interactive
verda ssh-key delete abc-123
verda ssh-key delete --id abc-123

# Agent mode
verda --agent ssh-key delete abc-123 --yes
```

## verda ssh-key list

List SSH keys

List all SSH keys in your account, showing Name, ID, and Fingerprint.

**Usage**

```text
verda ssh-key list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`

**Examples**

```bash
verda ssh-key list
verda ssh-key ls
```

---

Global flags such as `--output`, `--agent` and `--debug` work with every command: see [Global Flags](../commands.md#global-flags).
